fact: The Minister of Finance and Development Planning told Parliament on 19 February 2025 that the Government of Lesotho Enterprise Architecture and Interoperability Framework is being developed to improve efficiency and avoid fragmented ICT deployment across government.

fact: The Government of Lesotho issued Terms of Reference for development of the Government of Lesotho Enterprise Architecture (GLEA) and a standalone e-Government Interoperability (e-GIF) Framework; the document's landing page is dated 22 July 2024 and its body text was not retrievable.
